questions.q: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable that cannot be reassigned?
questions.explanation: const creates a block-scoped binding that cannot be reassigned after initialization.

questions.q: Which of these values is falsy in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: The number 0 is falsy, while the non-empty string, array, and object are truthy.

questions.q: What does typeof null evaluate to?
questions.explanation: typeof null returns "object" because of a long-standing JavaScript quirk.

questions.q: Which array method adds an element to the end of an array?
questions.explanation: push() appends one or more elements to the end of an array.
